units.source_text: “的确，我是在峨眉山上居住的仙人，我的号是铁冠子。

en.t: Indeed, I am an immortal who lives on Mount Emei, and my religious name is Tieguanzi.

units.source_text: 我第一次见你的时候，就看出你好似有点悟性，

en.t: When I first saw you, I could tell that you seemed to have some capacity for enlightenment,

units.source_text: 因此两次让你成为大财主。

en.t: and so I twice made you into a very wealthy man.

units.source_text: 你如果这么想修仙，那么我就收了你这个弟子吧。”

en.t: If you want so badly to cultivate the way of immortals, then I will accept you as my disciple.
